notes: Mage (idle-web-v2 witch), 68x67, 16 colours. r5 refine: light/mid/shadow pass on every surface — 5x4 eyes with a 2-tone iris (S light blue over J), 2-cell white catchlight and B pupil, 2-cell blush, mouth interior always ink/rose, blossom + ribbon + chest gem redrawn as clean 3-tone shapes, C highlight and P/M checker on the cone, B/M checker on the brim, L rim shadow under every lock, M rim on the cape hem, cape salt-and-pepper smoothed, the floating-hat gap made one continuous window. Motion per tier — sleep: lids shut (low ‿), hat tip droops right, z/Z/Z rise (2 fr); bored: idle · blink · hat nod + ribbon tail swing · hair-tip puff (4 fr); cruise: lock and cape hem drift left 1-3, tip eases back 1-3, left brim lobe lifts 1, smile (3 fr); fast: lock streams 3-5 cols as notched pointed strands (lit top / shadow bottom), right lock pressed 1-2, cape flaps 3-5, hat tip bent back 5-6 with the bent-over tip tucked 2-3 behind the cone, brim flutters 1-2, toothy grin, 4-5 speed lines (3 fr); top: hat floats 2 rows over a see-through gap, tip back 7-8 and tucked 3-4, star glints white, 3x3 sparkle eyes twinkling plus/diamond, shout, stream 5-7 cols, 5 speed lines + stars (3 fr) — dress, collar, hands and boots never move.
